subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-content opt-out, and what canonical config shape should own it?
rationale: The reported `ignoreFileContent` key is absent from current schema/docs, so the remaining work is a new channel policy/config decision rather than a proven shipped-setting regression.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current media download behavior and switches file messages to placeholder-only context when disabled.

options.title: Use Shared Media Policy
options.body: Design a broader channel attachment-ingestion policy if maintainers want one option shape across Feishu and other channels.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Clarify that Feishu currently supports media size limits but not a file-content ignore setting.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current media download behavior and switches file messages to placeholder-only context when disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: PR 47968 shows recent ownership of the Feishu media/docs surface most directly involved in this policy choice.
